## Observation datasets

### fes\_ono\_2006\_table1\_compression

- **Description:** All eight orthorhombic FeS-VI compression observations printed in Table 1 and used for the reported EOS fit.
- **Kind:** pressure\_volume\_lattice\_parameters
- **Reference:**
    - **Authors:** Ono; Kikegawa
    - **Year:** 2006
    - **Source:** American Mineralogist
    - **Volume:** 91
    - **Locator:** 1941-1944
    - **DOI:** 10.2138/am.2006.2347
- **Source location:** Table 1, journal page 1943
- **Associated EOS records:** fes\_ono\_2006\_bm3\_1
- **Notes:** The sample was transformed by laser heating and each observation was made after temperature quench. The article states that cell-parameter standard deviations were calculated from variations in diffraction d-spacings. Pressure is from the internal NaCl standard of Brown (1999).
